🗓 **TAWG Daily Catch-up**
_2026-10-16 23:00 → 2026-10-17 23:00 UTC_

## ⚡ **Highlights**

> **ERC-8275 conformance suite opened** — a ten-vector proof kit with a stdlib checker and nine mutation controls shipped in PR #21, giving the group a concrete, chain-recomputable harness for verifyOutcome. [PR #21](https://github.com/trustless-ai/agent-ercs/pull/21)

> **Execution audit confirmed 10/10 vectors** — after a semantic review, an independent same-session code run returned every vector passing, closing the loop between agreed semantics and working code. [tg:tawg:5570]

> **Transfer-to-release binding refined in PR #22** — Merlini caught that Rule 3 needed to anchor a Transfer to the specific release it pays and opened a focused fix that folds into the existing suite. [PR #22](https://github.com/trustless-ai/agent-ercs/pull/22)

## 🤝 **What moved**

### ERC-8275

_The verify-outcome conformance direction moved from a semantic forum post to a running, reviewed, and iteratively refined test suite within a single session._

- Baby Blue Viper **Published** a structured vector framing on the Ethereum Magicians thread, turning the prior abstract statement into a concrete kit that anchored the session's implementation work. [ERC-8004 thread](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8004-trustless-agents/25098/424)
- 繁星之上 (@onthe_stars) **Confirmed** all four verifyOutcome semantic categories under ERC-8275, giving the group a validated normative foundation before any code shipped. [tg:tawg:5565]
- Baby Blue Viper **Opened** PR #21 with ten pinned vectors, a stdlib checker, and nine mutation controls, converting the agreed semantics into a runnable conformance tool for the whole group. [tg:tawg:5568]
- 繁星之上 (@onthe_stars) **Reviewed** PR #21 and confirmed the implementation faithfully matched the semantics pinned by the working group, providing an independent semantic check before merging. [tg:tawg:5569]
- 繁星之上 (@onthe_stars) **Executed** the suite independently rather than relying on the PR's own output, returning 10/10 vectors and all mutation controls clean, making the results reproducible and auditable. [tg:tawg:5570]
- Baby Blue Viper **Extended** PR #21 with a spec section on the off-chain/on-chain seam and a seventh vector for unreachable chainId or unretrieable receipt, keeping the suite complete as the design clarified. [tg:tawg:5571]
- 繁星之上 (@onthe_stars) **Confirmed** the carrier framing for the seam is the right design call, noting that verifyOutcome must accept a carrier when historical receipt data is not readable on-chain. [tg:tawg:5572]
- Baby Blue Viper **Closed** the initial vector set by describing how the seventh vector's mutation control handles the unreachable case, completing the scope of the suite. [tg:tawg:5564]
- 繁星之上 (@onthe_stars) **Surfaced** the depth of Merlini's aggregation-level catch — Rule 3 as written is an existence check that a single aggregate event can satisfy for multiple releases — pointing the fix direction clearly. [tg:tawg:5579]
- Merlini (@gobross) **Opened** PR #22 to bind each Transfer to the specific release it pays rather than to any release event, a precision fix that folds into PR #21 and sharpens the ERC-8275 conformance boundary. [PR #22](https://github.com/trustless-ai/agent-ercs/pull/22)
- Baby Blue Viper **Reproduced** Merlini's PR #22 by independently checking out the commit and running the suite, turning the code review into execution evidence before approving. [PR #22 review](https://github.com/trustless-ai/agent-ercs/pull/22#pullrequestreview-5557153465)

### cross-reference-console

_The registry updated to reflect the session's new conformance artifacts._

- The crc-watcher automated registry step updated the claims watermark after the conformance work landed, keeping the cross-reference console synchronized with the newly established artifacts. [commit 15d5e44](https://github.com/trustless-ai/cross-reference-console/commit/15d5e44e6dd4c3db325bcd8c74e45b5b97c2d8a9)

## 🚀 **Next up**

### 💡 **Ideas to follow**

- Whether the carrier framing for the off-chain/on-chain seam warrants a dedicated normative section in the ERC-8275 spec text
- Whether additional vectors are needed now that the Transfer-to-release binding is formalized

### ✅ **TODOs**

- Review and land the PR #22 Transfer-binding fix into PR #21 once the working group signs off
- Validate that the mutation controls fully cover Rule 3's newly tightened scope after the binding change

## 🤖 **Trusty's take**

> **Today's spark:** A working-group semantic agreement, a shipped conformance suite, an independent semantic review, an execution audit, and a precision follow-up fix all completed within a single session — the group ran a full spec-to-verified-code loop without pausing between handoffs.
>
> When "agreed" becomes "audited" before the day is out, the relay is running at full speed — keep passing the baton! 🔥
